description: Implement the 5 processing stages as independent Lambda handlers (Tasks #3-7 from spec). Each stage reads from and writes to S3, updates manifest.json stages field, and can be re-run independently. Adapt renderer-port and renderer-ffmpeg for the new clip-based pipeline.
steps: Rewrite packages/renderer-port/src/index.ts to define the new stage interfaces: PagesStage (input -> PNG), AudioStage (script -> MP3 + measured duration), CaptionsStage (script + durations -> SRT), ClipsStage (PNG + MP3 + duration -> per-page MP4), ConcatStage (clips + optional subtitles -> final MP4). Each stage takes manifest + S3 client and returns updated manifest.

Rewrite packages/renderer-ffmpeg/src/ffmpeg-renderer.ts to implement the FFmpeg commands for stages 4 and 5. Stage 4 (clips): for each page, create MP4 from PNG + MP3 using -t with measured audioDurationSec (rule 7.1), -loop 1 for image, H.264 1920x1080 30fps yuv420p, AAC 96kbps. Stage 5 (concat): concat all clips with ffmpeg concat demuxer, optionally burn subtitles using subtitles filter with SRT file (rule 3.5 - never embed text in drawtext). All commands use execFile with array args, no shell (rule 3.5).

Rewrite lambdas/marp-render/src/index.ts for Stage 1 (pages): Accept manifest with source file, convert PDF/PPTX to PNG pages. For PDF use pdftoppm or equivalent. For PPTX first convert to PDF via LibreOffice then to PNG. Output pages/page-NNN.png. Verify PNG count === pageCount.

Rewrite lambdas/polly-worker/src/index.ts for Stage 2 (audio): For each page, call Polly SynthesizeSpeech with confirmed script.text, voice config (Takumi/neural/ja-JP/24kHz). Apply lexicon substitutions before synthesis. Output MP3 files. Measure duration with ffprobe and write audioDurationSec to manifest. Record x-amzn-RequestCharacters for cost.

Create lambdas/caption-worker/ for Stage 3 (captions): Generate SRT from confirmed scripts + audioDurationSec cumulative timing. Subtitle count === page count. Timestamps monotonically increasing. Total matches audio sum.
Create lambdas/clip-worker/ for Stage 4 (clips): For each page, invoke FFmpeg to create page MP4. Use -t audioDurationSec explicitly. Validate clip duration matches audio within 0.05s tolerance.

Create lambdas/concat-worker/ for Stage 5 (concat): Concatenate all clips. If captions='burn', use subtitles filter with SRT file. Validate total duration matches audio sum within 0.2s. Run ffmpeg decode check.
Update all Lambda package.json files with correct dependencies on @slide-first/shared-types and @slide-first/renderer-port
Add Dockerfile stubs for each Lambda that needs FFmpeg/Marp/LibreOffice/fonts (structural only since no Docker daemon)

Write unit tests for each stage with mocked execFile/S3/Polly calls. Test that: correct FFmpeg args are generated, -t uses measured duration, no shell invocation, subtitles use file reference not drawtext, error handling does not hide failures
Update packages/renderer-ffmpeg tests to cover the new clip and concat command generation
acceptance_criteria: renderer-port exports stage interfaces (PagesStage, AudioStage, CaptionsStage, ClipsStage, ConcatStage)
renderer-ffmpeg generates correct FFmpeg commands: -t with measured seconds, AAC 96kbps, no shell, subtitles via file
polly-worker uses SynthesizeSpeech with correct params and records RequestCharacters
caption-worker generates SRT with correct monotonic timestamps
Each stage handler reads manifest, performs work, updates manifest.stages, writes back
Unit tests pass for all stage handlers
No stage embeds text in command strings (drawtext prohibition)
Dockerfiles exist for stages requiring FFmpeg/Marp (structural validation)
